title: Normalize eight center chains and construct a conditional two-call consumer (no new K)
body:
The new PR4694 center interface observes 106 arbitrary helper inputs. This constructs a physically legal helper basis and inverse reducing those observations to **eight individual helper fields**, with **379 scalar gates at entry, 379 at exit and no new Gaussian call**. All original helper Gaussian jobs and the complete paid profile are preserved.

The actual eight-helper minor has determinant 64 and only dyadic-unit elimination pivots. Every affected helper has the same empty birth chart and complete nine-axis output chart, so the basis commutes with the identical exact Gaussian at every positive column multiplicity. Exact ranks `rank(K)=120`, `rank(K²)=8`, `K³=0` give eight size-three, 104 size-two and 408 size-one scalar Jordan blocks. Eight actual chains are explicit: pivot helper → center → Y scatter column. A general physical Jordan basis is not assumed free.

**A conditional two-call consumer is also constructed.** For a homogeneous three-field offer `U(Q)=I+Q(E12+E23)`, with symmetric `Q`, `Q⁴=I` and monomial `P=Q²`, exact scalar/Pauli boundaries satisfy `L U E D U^(-T) D R = diag(Q,Q,I)`. The actual raw dual includes its quadratic term, which is corrected explicitly. CONSUMER.md gives the all-width block proof and complete conditional moment with a shared transverse multiplier; consumer.py checks every coefficient in `Z[q]/(q⁴−1)` and five failure controls.

**No higher K or independent-center credit.** The real retained-center charts have not been embedded into that homogeneous offer at an affordable cost. Each normalized center output still contains its 56-term data observation, and all 112 Y outputs still receive incoming-center noise. A physical consumer with independently recovered Gaussian jobs and a positive complete moment is required before applying the conditional formula to the native invoice. The source's direct-cache and scalar-span failures remain in force.

Only `research/center-helper-normal-form/` changes against canonical main. Frozen PR4694 ABI, native payload and credited replay engine are actual inputs; their exact history is retained by a local tree-preserving provenance merge. The upstream PR is unchanged. PR4694's cache continuation already noted that the observed helpers are cold; that observation is credited. The new contributions here are the emitted physical basis, preserved helper jobs, explicit chains and conditional two-call identity. No priority claim is made for elementary block elimination.

Validation on final scientific head 9079ab66ba9a1717df478a08eb957c20d84d3e61: CPython 3.12.15 registered/native and isolated optimized replays; all 640 primal/raw-dual columns; basis/operator inverses; actual charts and paid ranks; positive scalar envelopes; native and conditional-controller failure controls; committed-byte/source-history preflight; 14-file export/archive checks; and fresh Git-free optimized export replay with PATH=/nonexistent. No new physical phase audit, selected cold replay, compiler/outer theorem or independent human review is claimed.

Source PR4694 frozen head 039a3e4f8906400cd05908ed86b8f9c6866e6113; refreshed head 2add42d1edf14a263abe90a3bcde67fc1ba30768 has identical ABI and native payload. Main remains b58ad9ef4d4e861b0eaa5dba41742bdc072dca51, selected conditional K=.00302015. Live queue and cached overlap were checked; sparse local coverage was incomplete.

Credit Cinna Davis's PR4694/4440/4441/4447/4470 lineage, Cao Yifan/PR4610, zxv, Jacob Alan Sussman and retained scalar, E8, Clifford, precision, compiler and outer contributors. Prepared for Cinna Davis with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no subagents; Apache-2.0.
